A [[festival]] is a celebration event of an in-game or real world seasonal holiday, usually introduced as a major feature of a [[release]]. Many of the festivals have been observed ever since the first ''[[Guild Wars]]'' series and include their own thematic [[zone|map]] decorations, activities, rewards, and [[daily|daily achievements]]. Recent festivals have lasted for about 3 weeks.

== List of festivals ==
=== [[Lunar New Year]] ===
[[File:Divinity's Reach (Lunar New Year) loading screen.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Late January to late February.''
Lunar New Year is a celebration of the new year in the [[Canthan calendar]] and of the particular Celestial Animal which will watch over Tyria during the coming year. It takes place during January or February, corresponding to the real-world [[w:Lunar New Year|Lunar New Year]].

It is held primarily in [[Divinity's Reach]] and it features lighting of [[firecracker]]s or other fireworks, opening [[Lucky Envelope]]s for a chance of [[gold]], [[luck]] or other seasonal items, and the [[Dragon Ball Arena]].
{{clear}}

=== [[Super Adventure Festival]] ===
[[File:Super Adventure Festival 2017 screenshot 2.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Mid April to early May.''
Super Adventure Festival's main attraction is the annual opening of [[Moto]]'s [[Super Adventure Box]] in [[Rata Sum]].

Originally created for [[April Fools' Day 2013]], Super Adventure Box is a special [[dungeon]] focused on old school platforming, with pixelated graphics and retro soundtrack, designed for both solo and [[party]] play. [[Bauble]]s and various coins can be gathered inside to exchange them for holographic weapon skins and other rewards.
{{clear}}

=== [[Dragon Bash]] ===
[[File:Lion's Arch (Dragon Bash) loading screen.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Early to Late June.''
Dragon Bash is a summer festival celebrating resistance and victories against the [[Elder Dragon]]s. The first edition of the festival was celebrated in [[Lion's Arch]] and then was moved to [[Hoelbrak]], where heroes from all across Tyria challenge themselves against holographic representations of Elder Dragon's minions, compete in races and other events. It also features recurring [[Hologram Stampede]]s in the four neighboring [[Shiverpeak Mountains]] zones.
{{clear}}

=== [[Festival of the Four Winds]] ===
[[File:Labyrinthine Cliffs.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Late July to late August.''
Festival of the Four Winds is a summer festival combining features of the original [[Bazaar of the Four Winds]] and [[Queen's Jubilee]] releases.

The [[Zephyrites]] land on the [[Labyrinthine Cliffs]] and bring various [[Activity|activities]], [[mount race]]s, [[adventure]]s and scavenger hunts. At the same time, [[Queen Jennah]] opens [[The Crown Pavilion (zone)|The Crown Pavilion]] with the [[Boss Blitz! Defeat all the champions in the Queen's Pavilion|Boss Blitz]] events fighting enchanted [[Watchknight]]s made to look like humanity's main enemy forces, and the [[Queen's Gauntlet]] arenas with increasingly difficult 1-on-1 fights against the queen's champions.
{{clear}}

=== [[Halloween]] ===
[[File:Mad King's Labyrinth loading screen.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Mid October to early November.''
Halloween, based on the [[w:Halloween|eponymous]] real-world holiday, is a festival celebrated in October and November.

During this time, the boundary between Tyria and the [[Underworld]]—in particular, the [[Mad King's Realm|realm]] of the [[Mad King Thorn]]—grows thin. Portals open up, spewing out various [[Halloween creature]]s into the world, while players can enter the realm for access to many activities, the [[Mad King's Clock Tower]] [[jumping puzzle]] as well as the [[Mad King's Labyrinth]]. The king himself attempts to break free back into Tyria for good and repeatedly visits [[Lion's Arch]], telling his characteristic jokes, playing [[Your Mad King says...|Your Mad King says]] while killing anyone who disobeys his commands.
{{clear}}

=== [[Wintersday]] ===
[[File:Divinity's Reach (Wintersday) loading screen.jpg|right|300px]]
:''Mid December to early January.''
Wintersday is a winter festival celebrating the new year in the [[Mouvelian calendar]]. It takes place in December and January, corresponding to the real-world [[w:Christmas|Christmas]] and the [[w:New Year|New Year]].

The festivities include several winter activities, including the [[Winter Wonderland]] jumping puzzle, [[Bell Choir Ensemble]], [[Tixx's Infinirarium]], [[Toypocalypse]] and the [[Snowball Mayhem]]. It is the season of giving and receiving [[Wintersday Gift|gifts]], with several donations of food, coins and clothing taking place around [[Divinity's Reach]].
{{clear}}

== Notes ==
* Festivals generally start at approximately {{UTC time|Tuesday 09:00 America/Los_Angeles}} and end at {{UTC time|Tuesday 12:00 America/Los_Angeles}}.
* Festivals use a special phasing technology that allows them to start and end without requiring any patch.
